import { customizeTable } from "@rebasepro/cms";
import type { areaTag } from "../../../backend/schema/area_tag";

export const areaTagCms = customizeTable<typeof areaTag>("area_tag", {
    icon: "Tag",
    hideFromNavigation: true,
    sort: ["lastUpdated", "desc"],
    fields: {
        lastUpdated: {
            readOnly: true
        }
    }
});
